name: Progress M-26M
about: Progress M-26M (2015-008A), a crewed vehicle (Progress MM), launched 2015 Feb 17. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2015 Feb 17), held fixed
docked to S26400; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
